_comment: Sedo ownership verification (TXT on the zone apex, host '@'), so the owner can list domains for sale on sedo.com. The value is the owner's Sedo verification ID, public by design (anyone can read it in DNS). Source: owner's message of 11 Oct 2026 with the Sedo guide ('Enter your new DNS record: TXT, Response = verification ID, Host blank or @'). Applied by .github/workflows/dns-records.yml to every zone in the Cloudflare account except the ones in 'exclude' (dawa.es is no longer the owner's).
